verdict.rationale: The official repo documents scaffolding a new app from first-party starter templates with `npx degit solidjs/templates/js my-app` [solid-gh-16]. It also says Solid integrates with the Vite ecosystem [solid-gh-15], which implies a fast dev workflow. Missing for 10: steps to install and run the dev server after scaffolding, a dedicated official CLI (e.g. create-solid) beyond degit templates, a TypeScript or other template variant, and independent hands-on evidence that setup really takes only a few minutes.
